mapper.select: INSERT INTO auth_identity (user_id, provider, provider_subject) VALUES ( #{userId, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{provider, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{providerSubject, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) RETURNING id

SELECT auth.id AS auth_identity_id, auth.user_id, auth.provider_subject AS normalized_email, credential.password_verifier FROM auth_identity auth JOIN local_password_credential credential ON credential.auth_identity_id = auth.id WHERE auth.provider = #{provider, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND auth.provider_subject = #{providerSubject, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
